question: H has three times as many cards as R has. If H gives 50 cards to R, R will have three times as many cards as H has. How many cards does H have?
solution:
Given :

H has three times as many cards as R has.

Let us consider number of cards R have = x

Number of cards H have = 3 × as many cards as R has.

Number of cards H has = 3x

If H gives 50 cards to R :

⇒ 3x - 50 = x + 50
